versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00304, SRS_Rte_00312 The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall provide the Rte_- Rips_ReturnResult Service for each operation instance in an AbstractRe- quiredPortPrototype of a Atomic Software Component if • for the related operation an AsynchronousServerCallResultPoint ex- ists AND • for the related Client Server Communication Graph the RTE Imple- mentation Plug-In support is enabled

The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall pro- vide the Rte_Rips_ReturnResult Service for each operation instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of a Atomic Software Component if • for the related Client Server Communication Graph the RTE Imple- mentation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794] or [SWS_Rte_08105].
